svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 03 · Davis · 05/12 Mondavi Center (Uncommon)
svg.desc: At dusk the big glass lobby glows like a lantern. Somebody inside is tuning up. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
